identification: Single-sided vitreous enamel street name blade 'ELIZABETH ST' (superscript T), white letters and double border lines on blue, flat steel, c1900-1940. Fixing holes at the four corners plus one through the centre (in the 'B'). About 63.5 x 13 cm. Chips and rust at all corners and holes, a rust patch over the 'S', a scratched 'V' at lower right. Back plain grey steel, rusty, unmarked. Old paper stock/inventory label reading '5648/9' on the face (cloud scan read 'S648/9'). No council or maker mark, so the town is unknown (Elizabeth St exists in Hobart, Launceston, Melbourne, Sydney, Brisbane and many others).
